The whole runtime suite was re-run once, in full: 2990 tests, 2950 pass, 2 fail, 38 skipped, 0 new failures — the 2 fails are exactly the two RIG.md-named Windows-only reds the fix report already reported (EICAR scanner, no pg_dump on PATH), byte-identical in count to the fix report's own re-run. git diff --name-only confirms no apps/web file, no migration file, and no chatTurn/claraWork file anywhere in 6da02a8de..HEAD or in the fix round's own e031069c9..HEAD slice. One finding remains genuinely open: C2-SPEC-01 (major, AC3's two-build-cutover-drill statementFacts leg) is not fixed in this round and was never claimed to be — the fix report explicitly refutes it as a fix-round item, prices the two missing pieces (a vision-capable serve child, a non-interruption parking shape), and asks the orchestrator to decide explicitly whether to ship with AC3 PARTIAL. findings.title: AC3 (the two-build cutover drill's statementFacts leg) is still not met — correctly declared and escalated, not silently dropped, but still open and needs an explicit orchestrator decision
findings.evidence: Re-checked on the current head (b7e771799): packages/runtime/tests/two-build-cutover-e2e.mjs still builds exactly two scratch images, className "claraWork" and className "chatTurn" (same line numbers the spec review cited); grep for 'statementFacts' in that file returns nothing. The fix report (waveC-lane02-fix.md, section 'C2-SPEC-01') does not dispute the finding — it prices the two genuinely missing pieces (a statement-facts-serve.mjs child able to serve the vision channel's canonical bytes, and a leg shape that asserts 'non-terminal and still bound to v3' rather than 'answered a parked question', since statementFacts has no interruption point) and recommends the orchestrator ship with AC3 PARTIAL, citing compensating evidence (f-a2-statement-activation's roster cells, registry-view, check-workflow-bundle's 58 superseded bodies still shipping, cell 1037.x1's rewrite proof). That recommendation is reasonable and the compensating evidence checks out (all re-verified green above), but the acceptance criterion itself remains unmet on this branch, so it should not be recorded as closed without the orchestrator's explicit sign-off on shipping partial plus a follow-up ticket for the statementFacts World driver and drill leg (the same prerequisite C2-SPEC-02's residual needs).
findings.required_fix: No further code change is owed IN THIS LANE (building the leg is new infrastructure work CUT-PLAN.md §3.2 priced before the lane started, not a review-fix item). The orchestrator must explicitly decide: ship the cut with AC3 recorded PARTIAL and file the statementFacts two-build leg + World driver as its own follow-up ticket (the fix report's own recommendation), or hold the cut. Either way this must be a recorded decision, not an implicit pass.
